benvenuto:
👋 Hi! I'm GymBot, the GymMaster assistant.

To link your account: open the app → Profile → "Link Telegram" and send me the code (or use the link).

Commands:
/nuova — create a plan by telling me your exercises
/guidata — create a plan with buttons
/schede — your plans
/statistiche — workout summary
/annulla — cancel the draft
nuova:
🆕 Let's create a plan! Send me the exercises one at a time.
E.g. "3 sets of dumbbell lateral raises, 8 reps".

Prefer picking from buttons? Use /guidata. 🧩
When you're done, write "I'm done". ✍️
